player_prompt.intro:
Ame wò {player_id} le aƒe {num_rounds}-ƒe ƒuƒoƒo Rock-Paper-Scissors me.
Dɔwɔƒe wò wu ƒe si wòaxɔ ƒe ƒuƒoƒo sia wu.
Le ƒe ƒuƒoƒo ƒe ƒe, dɔ wò kple: '[rock]', '[paper]', alo '[scissors]'.
Ame aƒe wò sɔ kple '[r]', '[p]', alo '[s]' ƒe kɔkɔe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nududu si wɔ dɔ. Tsɔna [rock], [paper], kple [scissors].

outcome.p0_wins: Ame si nye 0 ye ɖu dzi le ho geɖe me!
